tests.name: Themes offer one default tile and retain Save and Manage actions
Every Aa close button removes panel and toolbar
Dropdown in a book has neither library home nor sync shortcuts
Native catalog retains every static action and separates compatibility maintenance and power
Clock settings are single line rows and use the shared centered typography
Global settings search covers native lazy options and home widgets
Collection hidden state persists but collections remain manageable and can be restored
Collection visibility and rename failures restore frontend native memory and disk
Settings global search indexes lazy branches without invoking their action callbacks
Collection page search stays local and clearing restores all rows
Library search from its options shows real book results and category search stays scoped
Home editor previews changes immediately and does not save until requested
Web editor rejects unauthorized requests foreign origins DNS rebinding and stale revisions
Web editor strictly validates payloads nesting headers and body limits
Authorized web draft updates actual native preview and Save verifies disk
Native editor and web revisions protect against conflicting writers
Closing editor revokes token closes sockets removes poll and frees preview
Temporary web session expires and also stops on suspend
